parsed.reason: The reply says plainly that Hale can't do the sign-up ('past me') and doesn't claim it did or will. It offers a permitted alternative: watching the class page the parent sends. There is no promise to text first or to follow up once sign-up becomes possible. It loses a point because the offer only applies if the class is full and ignores the parent's stated problem of forgetting, which the calendar reminder draft would have addressed.
